title: Constitution of a Bench by the President of the National Commission

content.scenario: The President of the National Commission needs to constitute a Bench to hear a consumer dispute. The President decides to form a Bench with three members, including the senior-most member, to preside over the Bench.
content.outcome: The President of the National Commission constitutes a Bench with one or more members, as deemed fit, and the senior-most member of the Bench presides over it, in accordance with Section 58(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: How is a Bench constituted in the National Commission?
Who presides over a Bench in the National Commission?
What are the powers of the President of the National Commission?
